memberships.page_title: Exact Normal Linearization at the Plane Boundary

statement: The formally invertible change W=M0/(AB), T=sW^(1/S), H=(alpha log(B/B0)-beta log(A/A0))/S converts the full single-component determinant equation into a linear equation in H and W and decouples all normal orders before support restrictions.
